subject: prd/feature-brainstorm
statement: The skill shall confine its writes to its own record (and session scratch), making no tracker writes, creating no PRD ledger, and modifying no other document.
rationale: stage 1 precedes the artifact; a wide write perimeter is how side effects and drift enter
fit_criterion: after every fixture session, the working tree is clean except the record path; the docgate gate reports no governed-document change
